subject: Post-call: RAG pilot readiness — model fit recommendations and reranker decision
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@luminahealth.com>, Ops AI <ops+ai@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: RAG pilot readiness — model fit recommendations and reranker decision

Hi Elaine / Lumina team — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap and concrete next steps so we can lock the pilot scope and get benchmarks running.

Summary of needs we heard on the call:
- User scenario: clinicians search & summarize patient-specific notes (EHR) and get cited snippets for downstream triage.
- SLOs: P50 latency target <= 600ms for interactive UI, P95 < 1.8s; grounding precision target >= 95% for top-1 answer.
- Constraints: PHI containment; may need VPC/private deployment or redacted hosted sandbox depending on procurement timeline.

Recommended pilot plan (2-week technical qualification):
1) Models to evaluate (A/B):
   - RW-Gen-7B-q4 (fast, quantized low-cost baseline)
   - RW-Opt-13B-fp16 (quality-focused, higher context handling)
   - RW-Prod-3B (fallback for strict latency paths)
   We'll run identical prompt sets across each and measure grounding_precision@1, citation_coverage@3, hallucination_rate, and latency per token.

2) Retrieval & indexing proposal (initial):
   - Chunk size: 512 tokens, overlap: 50 tokens (to preserve sentence context)
   - Embedding model: rw-embed-2k (dense vectors, 1k–2k token support)
   - Index: FAISS HNSW (dense) + optional BM25 prefilter for recall spike
   - Retriever candidate_top_k: 100, rerank_top_k: 10
   - Reranker: CrossRank-v2 (cross-encoder rescoring) for final pass — we can A/B this vs a LambdaRank-trained reranker if you want to optimize for grounded citation precision.

3) Metrics & quality gate:
   - Grounding precision @1 (binary: does the top answer cite a correct source?)
   - Hallucination rate (manual sampled labeling + automated citation checks)
   - Latency (p50/p95) and cost per 1k queries
   - Regression monitoring: we’ll create prompt-specific eval suites (your 50 representative queries + blind test set) and enable automatic regression alerts if grounding_precision@1 drops >3% vs baseline.

Next steps for Lumina (asks):
- Provide a redacted sample dataset (3–5k notes) or allow us to run against a small sandbox export.
- Confirm whether you want a Hosted redacted sandbox (fast) or Private/VPC evaluation (longer setup, reqs from IT).
- Pick preferred latency target to bias the model choice (we recommended above).

Attachments: pilot_scope.xlsx (scope, milestones), benchmark_results_v1.csv (example format), prompt_set_v1.txt (seed prompts)

Links: shared Drive folder with templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPilotBenchmarks

If you confirm dataset access and deployment preference, we’ll stand up the first run (1–2 days) and send preliminary benchmark links within 72 hours.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine@luminahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ops AI <ops+ai@luminahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: RAG pilot readiness — model fit recommendations and reranker decision

Thanks Diego — very helpful summary. A few quick clarifying Qs: 
1) For PHI, our security team will push for Private/VPC. How long does Private take to provision vs hosted sandbox?
2) On the retriever side, will FAISS HNSW be hosted in our VPC for the Private option? We need encryption at rest and KMS integration.
3) Can you share a short cost delta (order-of-magnitude) between the RW-Gen-7B-q4 baseline and the RW-Opt-13B-fp16 option?

We can provide a redacted dataset this week if you can accept an SFTP drop; otherwise we’ll work with your sandbox option.

—Elaine Park
Director, Applied AI — Lumina Health
elaine@luminahealth.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: RAG pilot readiness — model fit recommendations and reranker decision

Thanks Elaine — answers inline: 
1) Private/VPC provisioning: ~2–3 business days for our standard Private evaluation (we’ll need an IP allowlist and KMS details). Hosted redacted sandbox is immediate (hours) and cheaper for an initial qualification run.
2) Yes — for Private the FAISS HNSW index runs inside your VPC on a dedicated node and supports KMS-backed encryption at rest. We’ll also provide audit logs.
3) Cost delta (very rough): RW-Gen-7B-q4 ~ 0.8x of baseline unit cost; RW-Opt-13B-fp16 ~ 3–4x unit cost depending on perf tuning and batch sizes. We’ll provide a more precise estimate after we pick the exact quantization / batch settings.

On regressions & monitoring: we propose creating 3 prompt groups (triage, summary, cite-extraction) and a blind test (200 queries). We’ll wire our Optimize toolkit to run nightly evals and send regression alerts to your team and ours if grounding_precision@1 drops >3% or hallucination_rate increases above a set threshold.

I’ll drop the HubSpot deal link and initial bench templates here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/DEAL-78921 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPilotBenchmarks

If you want, we can start with Hosted redacted sandbox today while we queue Private provisioning. Please confirm SFTP drop or sandbox.

—Diego

- Recommend we schedule a 30-minute technical working session this week to align on dataset handoff, SI contact, and reranker experiments. Karthik — pls own the reranker A/B: CrossRank-v2 vs LambdaRank (train on their annotation schema).

Thanks — Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: RAG pilot readiness — model fit recommendations and reranker decision

Nice summary — Quick technical plan we’ll run for the pilot: 
- Ingestion: chunking = 400 tokens, chunk overlap = 64 (we’ll evaluate 400/512 tradeoffs in run #2)
- Embeddings: rw-embed-2k, vector dim = 768
- Index: FAISS IVFPQ (for faster cold-start queries) with HNSW warmup if latency-sensitive
- Retriever candidate_top_k = 100, reranker rescoring on top 100 then final top 10 returned to UI
- Reranker baseline: CrossRank-v2 (cross-encoder), A/B with LambdaRank (trained on Lumina label schema)
- Eval probes: 200 blind queries + 50 seed prompts (triage/summary/cite-extraction)

Estimated runtime & cost: first run (hosted sandbox) to produce bench results ~72 hours of continuous runs; cost estimate (ballpark) $1.2k–$2.5k depending on model mix (Gen-7B vs Opt-13B usage).

I’ll add the reranker training harness and a sample eval notebook to the Drive folder and schedule the working session when Elaine confirms dataset handoff method.

—Karthik
Senior Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
